asset_policy: append-only content-addressed work files; never delete raw captures, cue audio, subtitles, segments, or prior takes

chapters.title_zh: 欢迎来到天朝大厂：你的封地，也有绩效季
chapters.title_en: WELCOME TO THE IMPERIAL MEGACORP: YOUR FIEF HAS REVIEW SEASON
body_en: Gameplay opens on the feature, never CK3 loading

cues.zh: 当上公爵还没来得及喝茶，绩效通知先到了。
cues.en: If you thought becoming a duke meant tea, marriage, and waiting for inheritance, you clearly have not received this quarter's review notice.

cues.zh: 《天朝特色361制》：不用读条，直接开会。今年这个 C，准备让谁背？
cues.en: ZhongGuo 361 Style: no loading screen, straight to the meeting. Who is carrying this year's bottom rating?

chapters.title_zh: 谁给谁打分：公爵以上都是经理，伯爵男爵只能被卷
chapters.title_en: WHO RATES WHOM: DUKES AND ABOVE MANAGE; COUNTS AND BARONS GET MANAGED

capture.shot: 同一存档依次打开天朝制公爵、伯爵、男爵角色页与直属关系；展示公爵的考核入口，以及伯爵/男爵只能收到上司告身。

cues.zh: 规则先说清：所有天朝制公爵及以上领主，都要给自己的直属官员做考核，不只皇帝。
cues.en: First, the reporting line: every celestial-government duke or higher rates their own direct officials, not just the emperor.

cues.zh: 伯爵和男爵也别高兴太早。他们不能考核别人，但会被上司考核；没有打分权，不代表没有被打分权。
cues.en: Counts and barons cannot rate anyone, but their superior still rates them. No management authority does not mean freedom from management.

cues.zh: 所以你既能主持名单，也可能下一秒收到上司告身：符合预期，翻译一下就是别问涨薪。
cues.en: You can host the list, then receive your superior's receipt: meets expectations, corporate for do not ask about a raise.

chapters.title_zh: OKR负责抬头看路，KPI负责低头看刀
chapters.title_en: OKR LOOKS AT THE HORIZON; KPI CHECKS THE BLADE

status.zh: 待录 KPI、政策卡与证据列实机

capture.shot: 录考核榜的 KPI/价值观列、两名官员的总督效率或贤能成长差异，再展示 #001 与 #002 政策卡的 A/B/C。不得把政策卡录成独立目标管理器。

cues.zh: KPI 不只看效率：贤能成长、上司评价、派系罪行、上轮京察和人情，都会入账。
cues.en: KPI is not just governor efficiency: merit, growth, superior opinion, factions, crimes, and last cycle's Jingcha record all enter the score.

cues.zh: OKR 和 KPI 在这里先是一张政策卡：你决定组织怎样记账；分数到了校准会，才变成能上桌的弹药。
cues.en: Here OKR and KPI begin as a policy card: you decide how the organization keeps score; at calibration, that score becomes ammunition.

chapters.title_zh: 强制分布：不是问有没有C，是问C姓什么
chapters.title_en: FORCED DISTRIBUTION: NOT WHETHER THERE IS A BOTTOM RATING, BUT WHO OWNS IT

status.zh: 验收夹具实机静帧：23人、7/16/0 分布；完整末位边界连续录屏仍待录
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · 23 PERSONS / 7-16-0; CLEAN BOUNDARY RECORDING STILL PENDING

source.label: GREEN acceptance fixture: managed scoreboard, 23-person cohort

capture.shot: 来自最终 GREEN 验收夹具的 23 人考核榜静帧，显示唯一名次与 7/16/0 分档。该轮全是首轮保护样本，未展示 3.25 边界；干净连续排名录像仍待录。

cues.zh: 361 的灵魂是强制分布：少数 3.75，多数 3.5，末位 3.25。大家都努力，也不妨碍有人必须背 C。
cues.en: The soul of 361 is forced distribution: a few 3.75s, most 3.5s, and a bottom 3.25. Everyone may deliver, yet someone must explain why they were not excellent enough.

cues.zh: 排名采用固定序位，平分也不会全员并列第一、集体冲进3.75。毕竟真正的大厂从不允许数学破坏组织目标。
cues.en: Ranks use a stable unique order. A tie cannot make everyone number one and flood 3.75, because mathematics must never obstruct an organizational target.

cues.zh: 当前这张 23 人榜是首轮新人保护样本，所以 7/16/0；常规老员工队列才会拍到真正的 3.25 边界。
cues.en: This 23-person board is a first-review newcomer-protection sample, hence 7/16/0; a regular veteran cohort shows the real 3.25 boundary.

chapters.title_zh: 校准会：用最礼貌的语气，讨论最不礼貌的名额

status.zh: 验收夹具实机静帧：校准会三条真选项；人物与代价的干净连续录屏仍待录
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · THREE REAL CALIBRATION CHOICES; CLEAN CONTINUOUS RECORDING STILL PENDING

evidence_sources.label: GREEN acceptance report: calibration and published scoreboard

capture.shot: 最终 GREEN 验收夹具中的真实校准会静帧，展示公示前的直接发布、保护与下压三条选择。边界人物、代价与结算的干净连续录屏仍待录。

cues.zh: 自动排名后、发榜前，玩家可以校准：直接公示，或在两个分档边界交换两个人。
cues.en: After automatic ranking and before publication comes calibration, where quota, evidence, favors, and political enemies all enter the same pot.

cues.zh: 你能抬末名 3.75，或把末名 3.5 压进 3.25；每次动笔有 25% 概率被全员看成考核黑幕。
cues.en: You can lift the last 3.75 or push the last 3.5 into 3.25; each pen stroke has a 25% chance of becoming a review scandal.

chapters.title_zh: 背靠背这张卡，先从同侪的人情账开始
chapters.title_en: BACK-TO-BACK, STARTING WITH A PEER FAVOUR LEDGER

status.zh: 待录互评与向上管理实机

capture.shot: 录同级封臣的举荐与攻讦互动、冷却和资源成本；结算后录目标的下一期 KPI 加10或减15。可附 #007 背靠背政策卡，不得制造匿名评分或项目 UI。

cues.zh: 背靠背不是一套匿名小作文系统；它先是一张政策卡，外加一笔更封建的人情账。
cues.en: Back-to-back is not an anonymous essay system here; it begins as a policy card plus a much more feudal favour ledger.

cues.zh: 举荐同僚，下期 KPI 加 10；攻讦同僚，七成让他减 15，三成自己社死。向上管理？先学会把人情写进分数。
cues.en: Recommend a peer for +10 next review; slander one for a 70% chance of -15 and a 30% chance of embarrassing yourself. Managing up starts by putting favours into the score.

chapters.title_zh: 京察：活动免费，不办的代价比较贵
chapters.title_en: JINGCHA: FREE TO HOLD, EXPENSIVE TO SKIP

status.zh: 验收夹具实机静帧：定期京察强制弹窗及拒办入口；完整拒办后果连续录屏仍待录
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · JINGCHA MANDATE AND REFUSAL ENTRY; CLEAN CONSEQUENCE RECORDING STILL PENDING

source.label: GREEN acceptance fixture: semi-mandatory Jingcha event

evidence_sources.label: GREEN acceptance report: free planner, refusal opinion, and KPI -50

capture.shot: 最终 GREEN 验收夹具的定期京察弹窗静帧，显示默认举办和拒办入口。报告验证其免费举办、拒办直属上司好感及下轮 KPI -50；同一因果链干净连续录像仍待录。

cues.zh: 京察定期弹出、半强制，而且免费。评价下属不是领导的兴趣爱好，是岗位说明书。
cues.en: Jingcha is a periodic semi-mandatory activity and costs nothing to hold. Reviewing subordinates is not a leadership hobby; it is the job description.

cues.zh: 玩家当然可以说不。自由一直都在，只是你的直属上司也会自由地降低好感，并把拒办写进下一次绩效理由。
cues.en: The player may refuse. Freedom remains, while the direct superior remains free to lose opinion and record refusal as a major reason in the next review.

cues.zh: 这笔账绑定发令上司：换个老板，陌生人不能捡走旧理由扣你分。流程终于有责任人。
cues.en: The reason is bound to its issuing superior: a new boss cannot pick up an old excuse to dock your score. The process finally has an owner.

chapters.title_zh: 考核榜与告身：终于有人告诉你到底排第几
chapters.title_en: SCOREBOARD AND RECEIPT: SOMEONE FINALLY TELLS YOU YOUR RANK

status.zh: 验收夹具实机静帧：所辖官员考核榜；本人告身与制度驾驶舱的干净录屏仍待录
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · MANAGED SCOREBOARD; CLEAN RECEIPT AND COCKPIT RECORDING STILL PENDING

source.label: GREEN acceptance fixture: real managed scoreboard GUI

evidence_sources.label: GREEN acceptance report: scoreboard GUI OCR and frozen rows

capture.shot: 最终 GREEN 验收夹具的所辖官员考核榜静帧，显示年度、人数、3.75/3.5/3.25 配额、名次、KPI、价值观、绩效和连续次数。其余两页干净录屏仍待录。

cues.zh: 考核榜不是闪一下就没的通知。每轮冻结人物、官职、KPI、价值观、名次、档位、连续次数和状态。
cues.en: The scoreboard is not a disposable toast. Each cycle freezes the official, office, KPI, values, rank, grade, streak, and follow-up state.

cues.zh: 你主持考核时看整张团队榜；你被上司考核时收到独立告身，直接写明上司是谁、你拿多少分、同组第几、绩效几档。
cues.en: Managers see the full team board. When your superior rates you, a separate receipt names the superior, your score, cohort rank, and grade.

cues.zh: 旧榜不会被调任或下一轮偷偷改写。过去的 3.25，像群聊截图一样，永远不会自动撤回。
cues.en: Old boards do not drift after transfers or later reviews. A past 3.25 stays like a group-chat screenshot that never unsends itself.

chapters.title_zh: 3.25不是表情包：国库、金币、俸禄一起有感觉
chapters.title_en: 3.25 IS NOT A MEME: TREASURY, GOLD, AND SALARY ALL FEEL IT

status.zh: 验收夹具实机静帧：上司给出3.25、三重扣款与一年俸禄削减；申诉改判后的对账连续录屏仍待录
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · 3.25 RECEIPT AND THREE-ACCOUNT PENALTY; CLEAN APPEAL LEDGER RECORDING STILL PENDING

evidence_sources.label: GREEN acceptance report: exact 50 treasury / 25 gold / 60 merit penalty and refund

capture.shot: 最终 GREEN 验收夹具的上司 3.25 告身静帧，直接写明地方国库扣50、个人金币扣25及一年俸禄削减。报告验证 merit 60 和一次性精确退款；干净前后对账录像仍待录。

cues.zh: 档位必须落到资源上才有手感：3.75 进奖励和晋升通道，3.5 保住节奏，3.25 才开始真疼。
cues.en: Grades need resource consequences. A 3.75 opens reward and promotion lanes, 3.5 keeps the normal cadence, and 3.25 starts a real improvement cost.

cues.zh: 3.25同时影响地方国库、个人金币和一年俸禄。组织说这是共同承担，翻译一下就是：团队预算和你钱包都要参加复盘。
cues.en: A 3.25 hits the local treasury, personal gold, and one year of salary. Shared accountability means both the team budget and your wallet attend the retrospective.

cues.zh: 罚没保存精确金额和本轮编号；翻案退的是这次实际扣的钱，不是系统心情好发代金券。
cues.en: The penalty records exact amounts and the review serial; a reversal refunds what this cycle took, not a goodwill coupon.

chapters.title_zh: PIP与末位：给你改进机会，也给上司腾椅子的机会
chapters.title_en: PIP AND THE BOTTOM: A CHANCE TO IMPROVE, AND A CHANCE TO FREE YOUR CHAIR

capture.shot: 录首次 3.25 告身与 PIP modifier；再录连续两次 3.25 后的末位名单、逐人夺爵/致仕互动及批量降岗/再观察选择。不得伪造 PIP 任务、支持预算或中期检查 UI。

cues.zh: 第一次 3.25 会挂上 PIP：一张一年期红牌，不是自动处决倒计时。
cues.en: The first 3.25 applies PIP: a one-year red card, not an automatic execution clock.

cues.zh: 连续两次末位才进淘汰阶梯：夺爵、致仕、降岗留用或再观察。有人毕业，有人的岗位毕业。
cues.en: Two consecutive bottom ratings enter the exit ladder: title removal, retirement, demotion, or another year. In the final review, someone graduates; sometimes the position graduates without them.

chapters.title_zh: 晋升包与HC：它们是政策卡，不是许愿池
chapters.title_en: PROMOTION PACKET AND HEADCOUNT: POLICY CARDS, NOT A WISH ENGINE

status.zh: 待录晋升通道、政策卡与组织账实机

capture.shot: 录连续两次 3.75 的晋升通道 modifier/任命候选加成，再展示 #020、#022 的 A/B/C 政策卡和驾驶舱 HC 压力。不得制造岗位空缺、答辩或增编 UI。

cues.zh: 连续两次 3.75，真实会开晋升通道并提高原版任命候选分。晋升包，是 361 卡组里的一种治理选择。
cues.en: Two consecutive 3.75 ratings open the real promotion track and raise native appointment candidate score. A promotion packet is a governance choice in the 361 deck.

cues.zh: HC 在当前版本是组织账与政策取舍，不是独立招聘模拟器：它会改变压力、预算和后续 KPI。
cues.en: HC, or headcount, is currently an organizational ledger and policy tradeoff, not a separate hiring simulator: it changes pressure, budget, and later KPI.

chapters.title_zh: 跨部门抢功：先把它写进制度，而不是编一个项目管理器
chapters.title_en: CROSS-TEAM CREDIT: WRITE THE RULE, NOT A FICTIONAL PROJECT MANAGER

status.zh: 待录抢功政策卡与同侪互动实机

capture.shot: 展示 #026 与 #028 政策卡、驾驶舱证据/互信账，以及同侪举荐/攻讦互动。不得制造项目 ID、依赖时间线、贡献/可见度双账或仲裁 UI。

cues.zh: 抢功、甩锅、可见度，已经写进 361 的制度题库；但当前不是一套带项目编号的项目管理器。
cues.en: Credit theft, blame, and visibility are in the 361 policy catalogue, but this is not a project manager with project IDs.

cues.zh: 你选择治理方向，账本结算证据、互信和交付；真正能直接害同僚掉分的，是举荐与攻讦互动。
cues.en: You choose a governance direction, then ledgers settle evidence, trust, and delivery; the direct peer-score tools are recommendation and slander.

chapters.title_zh: 绩效申诉：不是掀桌，是要求把桌上的账重新加一遍
chapters.title_en: PERFORMANCE APPEAL: NOT FLIPPING THE TABLE, JUST RECOUNTING WHAT IS ON IT

status.zh: 验收夹具实机静帧：3.25 告身内的申诉入口；改判、退款与修榜的干净连续录屏仍待录
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · APPEAL ENTRY ON A 3.25 RECEIPT; CLEAN REVERSAL RECORDING STILL PENDING

source.label: GREEN acceptance fixture: visible appeal entry on 3.25 receipt

evidence_sources.label: GREEN acceptance report: exact refund and stale-appeal idempotence

capture.shot: 最终 GREEN 验收夹具的 3.25 告身静帧，清晰显示申诉按钮。报告验证改判精确退款、停止未来俸禄削减及重复申诉幂等；改判界面与修榜的干净连续录像仍待录。

cues.zh: 被打 3.25 后，玩家能认命、摆烂、奋发，或者花影响力申诉。它不是掀桌，是请求上司改判。
cues.en: After a 3.25, the player may accept, disengage, improve, or spend influence to appeal. It is not flipping the table; it asks the superior to regrade.

cues.zh: 改判会修正档位、连续次数、PIP 和精确罚没；申诉不会让原处理凭空加重。
cues.en: A reversal updates the scoreboard, streak, and exact penalty. Review may maintain or reduce the decision; it cannot punish you merely for appealing.

cues.zh: 报告已实机对账：退款只退这次实际扣的钱，重复申诉也不会二次发奖金。算盘终于没有闹鬼。
cues.en: The live report reconciles exact refunds: only this cycle's deduction returns, and a repeat appeal cannot print another reward. The abacus is finally not haunted.

chapters.title_zh: 不只一个考核季：361张政策卡把组织慢慢养成怪物
chapters.title_en: BEYOND ONE REVIEW: 361 POLICY CARDS GROW AN ORGANIZATION OVER TIME

status.zh: 待录政策卡与驾驶舱实机

capture.shot: 一次集中录 #002、#007、#015、#020、#026、#035 六张不同编号政策卡的 A/B/C，再打开制度驾驶舱的 14 本账。可显示 AI 每轮批量处理十二张的代码/证据卡，但不得伪装为逐张真人录屏。

cues.zh: 核心考核之外有 361 张逐项政策卡：每张有 A/B/C、持久选择状态，后果收进 14 本组织账。
cues.en: Beyond core review are 361 individually numbered policy cards: each has A/B/C, persistent choice state, and consequences flowing into 14 organizational ledgers.

cues.zh: 它们共享 17 类后果 profile，不是假装 361 套独立小游戏：证据、互信、交付、稳定、人才、HC 压力和倦怠会一起变。
cues.en: They share 17 consequence profiles, not 361 pretend mini-games: evidence, trust, delivery, stability, talent, HC pressure, and burnout move together.

cues.zh: 玩家每轮通常只遇一张；AI 按性格与预算压力，每轮后台批量处理十二张。不是 361 封邮件，是 361 次制度偏好。
cues.en: Players normally see one per review; AI batches twelve per review from traits and budget pressure. Not 361 emails—361 institutional preferences.

chapters.title_zh: 一轮真实玩法：京察、KPI、校准、发榜、兑现
chapters.title_en: THE LIVE LOOP: JINGCHA, KPI, CALIBRATION, BOARD, CONSEQUENCE

capture.shot: 同一存档、同一 review serial 连续录：京察/立即考核入口、KPI 排名、校准、发布榜、个人告身、3.25 三账处罚，以及申诉或 PIP 的后果。政策卡可作为独立蒙太奇，不得拼成虚构的目标—项目—互评闭环。

cues.zh: 真正跑通的闭环是：京察一到，KPI 开算；直属名单横排，校准可动，榜单正式发出。
cues.en: The live loop is this: Jingcha arrives, KPI calculates, direct officials rank, calibration may intervene, and the board publishes.

cues.zh: 奖励、罚没、晋升通道、PIP、末位和申诉随即兑现；上轮档位、连击、人情和制度账，会回到下一轮继续算。
cues.en: Rewards, penalties, promotion track, PIP, bottom action, and appeal land immediately; last grades, streaks, favours, and policy ledgers return next review.

cues.zh: 你管的不是古代人力资源表格，是一套会记分、记仇、也记账的天朝大厂。
cues.en: This is not an ancient HR sheet. It is an imperial megacorp that keeps scores, grudges, and ledgers.

chapters.title_zh: 先看证据，再喊牛：宣传片也要过绩效
chapters.title_en: EVIDENCE BEFORE HYPE: EVEN THE PROMO HAS A PERFORMANCE REVIEW
body_zh: 同轮素材绑定同一证据
最终成片必须短于20分钟
body_en: Same-cycle footage binds to the same run
Final duration must remain under twenty minutes

cues.zh: 这是可调整的脚本和占位分镜。待实录就是真的待实录，漂亮卡片不冒充 CK3 已跑通。
cues.en: This is an editable script and placeholder animatic. Pending capture means pending; a polished card never impersonates live CK3.

cues.zh: 正式版会验时长、编码、字幕安全区、中文配音和无读条开场。宣传片自己不过验收，拿 3.25 也不冤。
cues.en: The final cut validates duration, codecs, subtitle safety, Chinese narration, and no-loading opening. A promo that fails review deserves its 3.25.

chapters.title_zh: 来吧，给天下打分——然后等天下给你打分
chapters.title_en: RATE THE REALM—THEN WAIT FOR THE REALM TO RATE YOU

cues.zh: 你可以做证据充分、愿意护人的领导，也可以把所有人卷到只剩漂亮报表；选择和账都会留下。
cues.en: You may lead with evidence and protection, or grind everyone down until only beautiful reports remain. Both paths exist, and the ledger remembers both.

cues.zh: 《天朝特色361制官员绩效考核》：请开始管理你的直属官员，并准备好在上司面前解释，为什么你的管理方式符合预期。
cues.en: ZhongGuo 361 Style: begin managing your direct officials, then prepare to explain to your superior why your management style meets expectations.

cues.zh: 祝各位年年 3.75。至于名额够不够——这不是我的问题，是下一场校准会的议题。
cues.en: May you earn 3.75 every year. Whether the quota allows it is not my problem; that belongs to the next calibration meeting.
